about_the_game:
X-WAR® is a virtual battle world where players can win in-game prizes through unique mechanics not found in any other game

You play as an ordinary citizen who has decided to make a living in a challenging and extremely dangerous way by competing against others in dynamic battles.

For winning firefights, you earn in-game prizes that will allow you to survive and improve your arsenal.

TOURNAMENTS




Participate in world tournaments, fight with other players and prove your superiority on the battlefield.

WEAPON CUSTOMIZATION




Unlock an arsenal of over 25 different weapons, upgrade them with over 200 unique modules. Create your perfect weapon customized to your play style.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION




Customize your character's appearance, choose from a variety of options, and create a unique fighter that stands out on the battlefield.

DIFFERENT GAME MODES

- Deathmatch: Become the sole survivor in this intense mode.
- Team Deathmatch: Fight alongside your friends against the other team.
- Bomb: Plan and execute strategic attacks to gain victory.
- Tournament: Participate in regular world tournaments.

INTERESTING MAPS




The game features a variety of maps, each offering unique tactical opportunities.

COOL ANIMATIONS


MODERN GRAPHICS

Enjoy incredibly detailed graphics and smooth, dynamic gameplay created using cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5 technology.

Join the community of X-WAR players and immerse yourself in thrilling battles that challenge your skills and strategy.

Download X-WAR now, engage in battle with others like you and qualify to win the jackpot!

name: X-WAR

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen with 4 physical cores
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon Rx 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen with 6 physical cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
